title: The Beginning of Infinity

blink.heading: Hard-to-vary explanations
blink.body: Good explanations resist trivial modifications. Myths are easy to alter; science isn’t.

blink.heading: The reach of knowledge
blink.body: Once you understand a deep regularity, it applies to places you’ve never been.

blink.heading: Problems are soluble
blink.body: All evils are caused by insufficient knowledge — and knowledge is creatable.

insights: Problems are inevitable. Problems are soluble. That’s the human story.
Optimism is a stance about the future, not a forecast.
applications: When stuck, ask: what is the bad explanation here, and what is the hard-to-vary alternative?
highlights: All evils are caused by insufficient knowledge.

flashcards.back: It is hard to vary while still accounting for what it claims to account for.
